message: Any non-interactive `pi -p` MUST close/redirect stdin (`</dev/null`) — omitting it hangs indefinitely with ZERO output, which reads as a slow model rather than a deadlock.
Run command -v pi before every dispatch; if it fails, refuse the route without constructing or launching a command.

Any non-interactive `pi -p` MUST pass `--offline`. Pi's startup network probes are not bounded by the dispatch timeout and hung past two minutes in this packet's live probe, which reads as a slow model rather than a stalled startup.

A `--model` passed to `pi -p` MUST carry its provider, as `provider/model`. A bare id resolves against Pi's own default provider, so the run silently uses a different provider's model instead of failing, and the LLM Gateway rejects the unqualified form outright.
